title: DR1 puts a "Notification tasklist" heading between the commodity totals and the tasks; the frontend drops straight from the totals into the first numbered section.

finding.frontend: After the two commodity counter cards the page renders "1. About the consignment" directly, at the same heading level as "Your commodities" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/template.njk:9 and :28-35). Nothing tells the reader that what follows is the task list, and the numbered sections compete with the commodities heading rather than sitting under a parent.
finding.prototype: DR1 heads the task list "Notification tasklist", at the same level as "Your commodities", and makes each numbered section a level below it (app/views/notification-hub.html:52-58). The page therefore reads as two named blocks: the commodity totals, then the tasks.
finding.difference: Add the "Notification tasklist" heading above the first section and drop the numbered section headings one level so they sit under it. This is copy plus heading level on one template; it changes what a screen reader announces as well as what is on the page.
finding.falsifiedBy: A frontend hub that renders a "Notification tasklist" heading between the commodity cards and the first task section.

relatedTo.why: one pass over the hub's headings
